# Lattice

> Web3 roles, gigs, talent, and salaries from public employer ATS boards. Not a marketplace and not an employer.

Lattice lists still-open roles pulled from Greenhouse, Ashby, and Lever JSON. Apply on the employer site. Pay is only shown when the board publishes it.

## Site

- Home: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/
- Roles: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/roles
- Companies: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/companies
- Gigs: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/gigs
- Talent: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/talent
- Salaries: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/salaries
- Learn: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/learn
- About: https://lattice-devtechedge1.vercel.app/about

## Optional
